ownership_rule: Task E observes and validates. Engine tasks own how their counters/receipts are produced. The telemetry contract must not alter evidence meaning, generation ownership, Champion identity, Teacher authority, Physics authority, loss, gradient ownership, or promotion logic.
purpose: Integration contract between the Task E qualification supervisor and the final Stage-2 integration burst driver.

telemetry_jsonl.counter_rule: all counters are monotone non-decreasing and include warmup; supervisor differences records inside the measured window

counters.barrier_block_seconds: cumulative wall-seconds blocked at tournament/commit barriers
counters.fp32_training_examples: cumulative examples processed by canonical FP32 training
counters.fsync_stall_seconds: cumulative wall-seconds blocked in fsync/fdatasync durability waits
counters.hdd_read_bytes: cumulative Stage-2 payload bytes read from HDD placement
counters.hdd_write_bytes: cumulative Stage-2 payload bytes written to HDD placement
counters.ssd_metadata_ops: cumulative Stage-2 metadata operations against SSD placement

gauges.teacher_worker_utilization_pct: 0-100 percent busy Teacher workers over the reporting interval
gauges.trace_worker_utilization_pct: 0-100 percent busy Trace workers over the reporting interval

telemetry_jsonl.minimum_frequency: at least 1 record every 2 seconds during the measured burst

timestamp.meaning: time.monotonic() from the same Linux boot; supervisor selects the measured interval
